scope: Additive TH18 Yeti and Yetimite parent-child baseline. Earlier frozen references are preserved unchanged.
game_version: The immutable source payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. Parent L8 was independently observed in client build 18.600.3 on 2026-09-16. The Yetimite table is current secondary content without a published client-build identifier.

sources.title: December Update - Patch Notes
sources.limitations: The official launch post establishes parent targeting, movement, housing, remaining-child release at death, and Yetimite defense priority, fourfold defense damage, splash, altitude targeting, speed and wall hopping. It does not publish individual Yetimite values, range, threshold, spawn geometry or timing.

sources.title: Yeti
sources.limitations: The independent dated game-file table confirms parent L1-L8 hitpoints and DPS, housing, target type, cadence, range and movement. It does not publish the Yetimite lifecycle or child table.

sources.title: Yeti and Yeti/Yetimite
sources.limitations: The current page supplies the 600-damage threshold, multi-threshold behavior, L1-L8 child HP and damage, range, splash radius, target priority, multipliers, self-sacrifice and post-2025 circular death formation. It does not identify a client build or publish a child attack delay, exact spawn geometry, jump trajectory or target-ordering contract.

sources.title: Yeti CoC 2026 - Max Level 8, Stats & Attack Guide
sources.limitations: This independent current guide corroborates parent level-eight values, 600-damage multi-spawn, child levels, defense and resource multipliers, wall jump and self-destruction. It is not a primary source and does not publish a verified child cadence or coordinate contract.

damage_spawn_threshold.note: Every complete 600 damage accumulated while Yetimites remain releases one child. The October 2024 update confirms a single hit can cross multiple thresholds.

support.note: Core materializes L1-L8 parent levels, serialized threshold state, spawned-only child levels and sourced wall jumping. Missing timing and geometry remain partial.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only L1-L8 parent with its defining Yetimite lifecycle intentionally disabled.
changed_values.replacement: The L1-L8 parent materializes through shared Core. Each 600 accumulated post-mitigation damage releases a sourced child up to capacity and death releases the remaining capacity through the stable spawn queue.
changed_values.justification: The official launch establishes the parent-child behavior and public secondary sources now provide a sufficient threshold and child level table to implement a deliberately partial, reproducible baseline.

changed_values.previous_state: Required spawned subunit was inventory-visible but absent from the normalized catalogue and Core.
changed_values.replacement: The separately hash-pinned L1-L8 child table is spawned-only. It prioritizes defenses, jumps only walls in Core pathfinding, deals source-backed splash and self-destructs after its first impact.
changed_values.justification: The child table and behavior are sourced, while unknown cadence and geometry are explicitly left unresolved rather than manufactured.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source publishes the exact Yetimite attack entry delay or cadence. The Core therefore schedules its one documented self-destructive impact on the next 10 ms logical tick after it can attack. This is an explicit deterministic scheduling boundary, not a claim of calibrated timing.

The 2025 circular death formation has no public radius, orientation, tick delay or individual coordinate table. The stable Core spawn queue keeps the parent coordinate and does not present its layout as faithful.
Wall jumping is implemented as wall-only navigation occupancy bypass. Exact jump arc, time, collision and interactions with traps, spells and building corners are unverified.

Core currently categorizes an armed Town Hall as a resource building, not simultaneous resource and defense. Yetimite's documented combined twofold armed-Town-Hall multiplier is therefore not claimed or implemented.
The child visual levels and sprite source are unverified. Viewer fallback rendering is adapter visibility, not asset completion.
The parent and child retarget contract involving heroes, Clan Castle reinforcements and other excluded combatants is outside current scope and is not implemented.
conclusion: Yeti L1-L8 and spawned Yetimite L1-L8 are shared Core, headless, Viewer and RL entities for their source-backed parent-child baseline. The increment remains partial until child timing, spawn formation geometry, jump geometry, armed Town Hall classification and verified assets are sourced.
